query:
update moderation_flags f set status = 'rejected', resolution_note = $3,
                      resolved_by = $4, resolved_at = now()
               from blobs b
               where f.blob_id = b.id and f.status = 'open'
                 and b.sha256 = (select sha256 from blobs where id = $1)
                 and f.id <> $2
